parts:
With 39 responses, Wed 1-3 ahead to be the winning time for D-RUG this fall.  If you haven't yet voted, do so here to help select a time: http://goo.gl/buWj1F

Note that I had to drop 3-5 Thurs as a potential time due to a conflict.

I'll keep voting open through Thursday and announce a time on Friday.



Cheers,
